description: A Jellyfin plugin that adds a coverflow page for browsing music albums, with an album track list and play through Jellyfin's existing player. UI only — no custom player, no separate auth, LAN only. Prototype (0.2.0.0): the plugin registers its page; the album list and coverflow view land in later phases. Built against the 10.9 API floor (net8.0, targetAbi 10.9.0.0) so one build loads on Jellyfin 10.9 through 12.x.
name: MUNICombCoverFlow
overview: Browse your Jellyfin music albums in a 3D coverflow, from Jellyfin's own main menu.
